title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Riverport Amphitheatre, Maryland Heights | 2000
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Riverport Amphitheatre in Maryland Heights, Missouri, USA, on 28 May 2000.

It was the 13th show by the sixth All-Starr Band. Their North American tour lasted for 32 dates between May and July 2000.

Starr had previously performed at the Riverport Amphitheatre on 26 June 1992 and 10 May 1997.

The sixth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Dave Edmunds: vocals, guitar
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Eric Carmen: vocals, keyboards, guitar, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, guitar, organ, keyboards, percussion, harmonica
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums
